==About me==

I am a freelance graphic and web designer and video game enthusiast. Pretty boring, but feel free to take a look at [http://www.rhodelander.com my portfolio] if inclined to do so. :)

==Wheel of Time History==

First thing to know is I'm a complete nerd when it comes to ''Wheel of Time''. My love for the series started when a friend let me borrow ''Eye of the World''. Admittedly, I had trouble getting through the first three chapters of the book because it wasn't all that interesting. I even had to start over and give it a fresh attempt. Anyway, I was hooked once I got past those first few chapters and Rand with his posse leave Edmond's Field.

Soon thereafter, I started playing The Wheel of Time PC game and joined The White Tower clan. While there I joined the Brown Ajah and worked on the clan's library, developing information for and recording strategies to be used within the game, as well as the overall content of the clan web site. Yeah... Nerd :)
